prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished Chinese educational infographic for a serious long-form computer science article. Wide landscape, high resolution, cream background, dark navy typography, restrained teal and amber accents, generous whitespace, crisp readable simplified Chinese. Title exactly: 数据系统的共同底层. Three columns with clear left-to-right arrows, header labels exactly: 约束 / 基本机制 / 工程落地. Four aligned rows. Row 1: 硬件会坏 → 冗余与恢复 → 副本 · 备份 · 纠删码. Row 2: 通信不确定 → 确认与重试 → 幂等 · 去重 · 事务. Row 3: 并发会冲突 → 版本与协调 → 快照 · 锁 · 共识. Row 4: 资源有上限 → 分摊与复用 → 分片 · 批处理 · 索引. Bottom footnote exactly: 先明确目标与假设，再选择机制. Small elegant server, network, version and memory illustrations aid comprehension. No other text, no English, no watermark. Arrows express design reasoning, not uniqueness or universal inevitability.

Use case: scientific-educational. Chinese technical infographic, wide landscape, cream navy teal amber palette, consistent book illustration style. Title: 冗余必须跨越故障范围. Three panels left to right. Panel one heading: 同一台机器. Show two disks inside one server sharing one red broken power source. Label: 双盘仍可能一起不可用. Panel two heading: 不同故障域. Show two independent rooms with servers and a replication arrow, one room failed, second operational. Label: 隔离相关故障. Panel three heading: 独立历史备份. Show a live database sending a deletion to live replicas while separate older snapshot remains intact. Labels: 误删除会传播 and 保留可恢复的过去. Bottom caption: 副本保护在线服务，历史备份保护恢复选择. All visible text simplified Chinese exactly as specified, readable and spacious; no English or watermark. Do not imply backup ensures immediate availability.

Use case: scientific-educational. Chinese distributed-systems sequence infographic, wide landscape high resolution, cream background navy text teal arrows amber caution. Title: 超时以后，操作可能已经成功. Main left panel two vertical lifelines headed 客户端 and 服务端. Time flows downward. First solid arrow client to server labeled 请求：操作甲. At server a green box labeled 业务已提交. Return arrow toward client stops at red cross halfway and label 确认丢失. Client then shows 超时 and a new solid arrow labeled 重试：仍是操作甲. Server a box labeled 查到记录，返回原结果. Right panel heading: 同一个本地事务, enclosed box contains 去重记录 and 业务修改 joined with plus sign, below exact line 一起提交，或一起撤销. Footer exact: 稳定标识让重试可识别，原子提交避免重复效果. Do not show a fresh identity on retry. All text Chinese, no English, no watermark.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Chinese technical editorial infographic, wide landscape, cream navy teal amber consistent style, readable simplified Chinese. Title: 一份变化历史，多种状态表示. Left a horizontal ordered strip of exactly three event cards: 创建订单 / 支付成功 / 订单取消. Header above strip: 有序事件记录. Fan out arrows from strip to three independent projections on right labeled 订单查询表 / 搜索索引 / 统计视图. Lower separated inset heading: 加快恢复. Depict 快照 + 后续日志 → 当前状态. Footer: 重放需要明确顺序、确定性与历史保留范围. Tiny order table and magnifier and bar chart illustrations; all labels specified Chinese only, no code, no English, no watermark. Do not imply all database WAL is a business event log; this illustration specifically uses business events.
edit_prompt: Edit this Chinese educational diagram, preserving its cream/navy/teal style and the clear three-event-to-three-views structure. Make these technical corrections and simplify text. 1. Replace the sentence below the event cards with exactly: 按日志定义的顺序重放，不依赖墙钟排序. 2. Remove all dates, timestamps, amounts, numeric IDs and extra data rows from the three event cards and all right-side boxes. Keep event labels 创建订单 / 支付成功 / 订单取消. In 订单查询表 show only a single status label 当前状态：已取消. In 搜索索引 show only a magnifier icon and label 按条件检索订单. In 统计视图 REMOVE the misleading increasing bar chart entirely. Replace it with three equally sized neutral tiles, with no numeric values or bar heights, labeled 创建次数 / 支付次数 / 取消次数. 3. In the snapshot inset remove dates, times and IDs, keep 快照 with 订单状态：已支付 plus 后续日志 with 订单取消 yields 当前状态 with 订单状态：已取消. Keep title 一份变化历史，多种状态表示 and footer 重放需要明确顺序、确定性与历史保留范围. All text simplified Chinese, no English, no fabricated quantitative chart. This is a conceptual example of business events.

prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create spacious Chinese infographic in cream navy teal amber palette, landscape. Title: 并发冲突的三种处理思路. Three equal panels. Left heading 先排队, show two operations waiting before one resource, label 锁与串行执行, footer 冲突前等待. Middle heading 先执行再验证, show two actors reading version 甲, one wins commit to version 乙, other gets retry arrow; label 版本检查与重试, footer 前提失效就重做. Right heading 设计成可合并, show separate counters plus one and plus two merging into plus three; label 可交换操作, footer 顺序不同也能收敛. Bottom note exactly: 选择取决于业务不变量，收敛不等于满足所有约束. No other text, no English, no watermark. Make panels illustrative not mathematically ambiguous.

Use case: scientific-educational. Wide Chinese technical infographic, cream navy teal amber, clear readable Chinese. Title: 队列只能缓冲，不能创造处理能力. Two horizontal comparison panels. Top label 无限制接收, show incoming tasks faster than worker, a long growing queue and overload red marker. Text: 流入持续大于流出 → 积压不断增长. Bottom label 有界接收, show admission gate before limited queue and worker, feedback arrow worker to gate labeled 背压, separate rejected requests arrow labeled 拒绝或降级. Bottom text: 批处理降低单位成本，限流控制进入速度. Use visual width and counts not quantitative chart; all text Chinese only, no watermark.

Use case: scientific-educational. Chinese educational systems diagram, landscape, cream navy teal amber, spacious typography. Title: 什么时候可以忘记过去. Main upper diagram three consumers labeled 消费者甲 / 消费者乙 / 消费者丙 along three parallel ordered log timelines. Positions: 甲 at event 8, 乙 at event 5, 丙 at event 7, but display Chinese numerals 八 五 七. Shade shared left portion through 五 teal and mark vertical boundary at 五 labeled 最慢进度. To its left label 候选回收范围. To right label 仍需保留. Bottom three icon cards: 旧版本 / 历史日志 / 删除标记. Footer exact: 还须检查快照、保留策略与离线节点；进度不是唯一条件. Purpose explain shared low-watermark reasoning without falsely asserting that consumer offsets alone authorize deletion. No English, no watermark.
